tools.name: investor_lenders_by_state
tools.description: Top investment-property lenders in any one of the 50 states and DC, from 2025 HMDA loan-level data: lender name, LEI, loan count, volume, average loan and purchase share, plus state totals and the retrieval date. Read-only; figures are the filing record, not a recommendation.

state.description: Two-letter state code, one of NJ, FL, PA, NY, TX, GA, NC, TN, OH, AZ, CA, CO, VA, MD, CT, IL, MO, MI, IN, OK, WA, AL, MA, SC, MS, NM, WI, LA, AR, KY, MN, OR, KS, IA, UT, NH, ID, WV, ME, MT, HI, RI, NE, DE, ND, NV, SD, WY, AK, VT, DC

tools.name: investor_lenders_aggregate
tools.description: Every HMDA filer across the 50 states and DC grouped by LEI and ranked by 2025 investor-property loan count, with the number of those 51 jurisdictions each filer reported in, the universe totals and the top-25 concentration share. The same computation https://dominickprevete.com/investor-property-lenders renders. A national aggregate.

tools.name: hmda_methodology
tools.description: How the investor-lender data is built: the filter definition, the server-side versus local filtering split, the vintage and retrieval date, the covered states, and the stated limitations an agent should attach to any figure it reports.

tools.name: glossary_lookup
tools.description: Definitions from the DSCR and investor-loan glossary (26 terms). Pass a term to look it up (case-insensitive, partial matches accepted) or no argument to list every term. Definitions describe what a term is; none states a program parameter.

term.description: The term to look up; omit to list every term

tools.name: loan_programs
tools.description: The National Loan Provider program set — dscr, dscr_cash_out, short_term_rental, dscr_5_10_unit, fix_and_flip, ground_up, rental_portfolio, bridge, commercial — each with the parameters its page already publishes, its starting rate from the site's single rate source with the as-of stamp, and the page URL. Where a page states no figure, the tool states no figure.

program.description: Program key to filter to; omit for all. One of: dscr, dscr_cash_out, short_term_rental, dscr_5_10_unit, fix_and_flip, ground_up, rental_portfolio, bridge, commercial

tools.name: rate_ranges
tools.description: Indicative starting rate by program, from the site's single rate source, stamped with its as-of month (currently November 2026). These are the published ranges, not pricing on any deal.

program.description: Program key to filter to; omit for all. One of: dscr, dscr_cash_out, short_term_rental, dscr_5_10_unit, fix_and_flip, ground_up, rental_portfolio, bridge, commercial

tools.name: about_national_loan_provider
tools.description: The entity answer: legal name, business model (it arranges, structures and places business-purpose financing across third-party lenders, and the lender that funds a loan makes the credit decision), business-purpose scope and the owner-occupied exclusion, address, phone, the states with published investor-lending data, and the canonical Person @id for the founder.
